description: Ministry of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs -  Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1603/35 of  28.05.2009, adding "17.  Department of Allied Health Science" to the University of Sri Jayawardenapura
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of a university. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending the legal framework governing university structures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
